name: The Athenaeum Hotel
positioning: Independent Mayfair hotel on Piccadilly, opposite Green Park, welcoming guests since 1850, with rooms, suites and townhouse residences
best_for: Travelers who want rooms and suites looking over Green Park
Families and long-stay guests who want a residence with a kitchen and hotel service

facts.text: The hotel sits opposite Green Park, steps from Buckingham Palace.
The Athenaeum has welcomed guests to this corner of London since 1850.
Many rooms and suites face Green Park or look over the rooftops of Mayfair, with Art Deco details.
The View Penthouse suites on the 10th floor have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the London skyline.
The 10th-floor suites have British-made Paul Smith toiletries, a partnership exclusive to those suites.
View Penthouse suite guests are greeted on arrival by a personal concierge, reachable 24/7.
The Spa at The Athenaeum offers calm treatments using natural British products.
The spa has a steam room and relaxation space, and in-room treatments are available.
The gym is open 24 hours, with Peloton and Technogym equipment.
116 at The Athenaeum serves modern British dining and is open to guests and locals.
The Terrace on Piccadilly is framed by a living wall that the hotel describes as the oldest of its kind in London.
The concierge team can secure event tickets, tables at exclusive restaurants or private art gallery showings.

highlights.text: Both View Penthouse suites have private balconies looking over Green Park towards Buckingham Palace.
Green Park Suites have floor-to-ceiling views over Green Park and separate living spaces.
The townhouse residences have a proper kitchen, a separate sitting room and the full attention of the hotel team.
The concierge team keeps kites and bikes for families who want an afternoon in the park.
Spa treatments are offered in partnership with skincare brand Temple Spa.

considerations.text: A service charge is added to the bill unless the guest asks for it not to be.
Superior Townhouse Rooms are located in the separate townhouse residences.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the Mayfair location.
